newly_exposed_gap.reason: Polynomial unique-state count alone does not imply polynomial total time if retained local resolvents make individual residual representations superpolynomial in original input length.
newly_exposed_gap.interpretation: This is an upper-envelope weakness, not evidence that exponential state growth must occur. A separate polynomial state-size invariant is required.

attacks.claim: Exact memoization makes arbitrary CNF search polynomial.
attacks.reason: Known Formula-Caching lower bounds show exact residual caching alone admits exponential hard families.

attacks.claim: Polynomial local Resolution budget per state implies polynomial total runtime.
attacks.reason: The number and representation size of states remain unbounded by a polynomial in the original input length.

attacks.claim: A polynomial unique-state bound alone closes the bridge.
attacks.reason: A polynomial state-size and worst-case primitive-cost invariant is also required.

attacks.claim: Finite GT growth establishes an asymptotic polynomial or exponential law.
attacks.reason: Finite observations can falsify frozen envelopes but cannot establish a universal asymptotic theorem.

attacks.claim: The one-layer local Resolution rule cannot destroy the historical Formula-Caching lower-bound witness structure faster than polynomially.
attacks.reason: A single derived clause may remove exponentially many future branch states; bounded-witness-destruction remains unproved.

attacks.claim: Expected hash-table behavior is enough for a worst-case polynomial theorem.
attacks.reason: A deterministic worst-case representation and dictionary/canonicalization cost model is required.

conditional_bridge.conclusion: TOTAL_DETERMINISTIC_TIME = O(N^(c+q)) up to fixed encoding factors; therefore CNF-SAT in P and P=NP.

killer_lemmas.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_COUNT
killer_lemmas.target: For every input CNF F of length N, S(F) <= N^c for one fixed c.

killer_lemmas.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_SIZE
killer_lemmas.target: For every state reached from every input CNF F of length N, bit_length(state) <= N^a for one fixed a.

decision_rule: If both killer lemmas are proved under deterministic worst-case primitive costs, promote bridge to PROVED and infer P=NP. If either is refuted by an explicit infinite family, mark the current Policy-0A bridge DEAD and preserve the family as the next design constraint.
